Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing on behalf of Maison Demo (demo merchant), sender of the parcel below, to report a parcel delivered open with an item missing (partial loss).

- Carrier: Mondial Relay (Mondial Relay Point Relais)
- Tracking number: 99100404
- Order: #1004
- Weight: 2.6 kg
- Value of the contents: €84.00
- Delivered on: 26 October 2026
- Damage reported on: 27 October 2026

Damage found: Matching saucers, set of 4 (item missing, major damage). The attached photos show the state of the parcel and of the product.

Compensation claimed: €25.00, under the terms of your contract (details in the attached claim file).
This claim is filed in time: the claim deadline is 29 October 2026, 11:35 (Paris time).
Reserve deadline: 29 October 2026, 11:35 (Paris time).

Please find attached the claim file (PDF) and the photos. The purchase invoice of the contents follows or is attached separately.
Please confirm receipt of this claim and keep me informed of its progress.

Kind regards,
Maison Demo (demo merchant)
12 rue de la Démo, 75011 Paris, France
claims@maison-demo.example

Mondial Relay recipient FAQ, my parcel is damaged (refuse the parcel)
French Commercial Code, art. L133-3 (3-day protest after receipt, carrier liability)

figures.label: Indemnity per parcel (loss or damage)
figures.note: Offre Start general terms of 2025-09-01. Shipping fees are not refunded.

figures.label: Time limit to claim for visible damage
figures.note: Counted here in calendar hours (public holidays are not skipped), so the computed deadline is never later than the real one.

figures.label: Reserve window after delivery
figures.note: Same 72 h clause as the claim deadline.

figures.label: Damaged parcel must be refused at delivery
figures.note: The FAQ says claims made after the parcel was handed over are not taken into account. Lockers differ (written reserves) and are not modelled.

notes: Figures are for the standard Offre Start contract; merchants with a negotiated contract may have other terms (not public). UNVERIFIED for those merchants.

The recipient must refuse a damaged parcel at the relay point or at home; otherwise the claim is not admissible. The order does not record whether the customer refused it, so computeClaim takes it as an optional input and adds a warning when it is unknown.
Optional paid levels (50 to 500 EUR) exist but cannot be added after shipping and are not modelled.
Claims go through the Connect tool or an e-mail to offrestart@mondialrelay.fr; no claim API was found. Compensation is paid to the prepaid account.
A parcel declared delivered but never received is a different procedure (1 month, sworn statement and ID copy) and is out of scope: send it to a human.
